name: notes-webapp

dependencies.name: notes-api
dependencies.description: Lists notes and posts a new note.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs team members in through single sign-on.

description: Single-page board where a signed-in team member writes a note of up to 280 characters and reads all notes, newest first, with author and time. Holds no data of its own and does not edit, delete, notify or attach.
